summary: Full end-to-end UI testing of the new Super Admin 'Messaggi' feature + Dashboard banner for Organizations. All critical flows pass: SA list/create/edit/toggle/delete, stats dialog, draft vs published visibility, targeted org isolation, per-user read/hide/ack buttons, hidden state persistence after reload, and SA stats update after user actions. Backend-only tests were skipped per request (already validated via curl).

issues: Minor: 'Nuovo' indicator uses low-contrast gray text (text-slate-500) on tinted card backgrounds; could be bolder/darker for better accessibility.

critical_code_review_comments: Only observation: during account switch via Playwright, context.clear_cookies() alone wasn't enough — leftover localStorage from the previous session caused brief 403 bursts on /api/dashboard, /api/events, etc., until a hard reload. Not a real-user issue (users log out via proper flow), but worth confirming logout endpoint also clears any localStorage auth tokens if used.
